input_zh: 在固定 main 提交 f1f97706790d3ebd1c57b072962fbcdd2361be10 上执行 Runtime V5 Production Deadline Recovery。当前 CONTROL 与 MANIFEST 均声明 Production Prompt v2.5.0，路径 research/runtime/worker-prompts/generated/production.prompt.md，SHA-256 为 5ee1675609c7b6b5f746108d0e8c5551824cb8fdd76605e89dfaf766ae62743c。main 上最新同日 checkpoint 虽为 admission-and-inputs-verified，但绑定的是已过期 Prompt v2.4.0 / SHA-256 725b82ba9480473ce84645e1d16784b6009cbe7db7ab25d338b8ae8f461ca3fc。
workResult: Recovery did not reuse the stale checkpoint and did not enter drafting, cover generation, candidate staging or Publication. The available connected-repository execution path could read the current Prompt and its declared hashes, but could not independently execute SHA-256 over the pinned Prompt bytes. Under the recovery hard lock, declaration agreement is not equivalent to hash verification. Because runDate, pinned main HEAD, Prompt path/version and independently verified SHA-256 could not all be established simultaneously, the recovery fail-closed before admission.
workResult_zh: 本轮没有复用陈旧 checkpoint，也没有进入正文、题图生成、Candidate staging 或 Publication。当前连接仓库执行通道能够读取 Prompt 及其声明哈希，但不能对固定提交中的 Prompt 原始字节独立执行 SHA-256；两个声明文件一致不能替代哈希核验。由于 runDate、固定 main HEAD、Prompt 路径/版本与独立核验 SHA-256 无法同时成立，本轮按硬锁在 Admission 前 fail-closed。
output: No Production Candidate was created. No cover image was generated. Publication remains ineligible.
output_zh: 未创建 Production Candidate，未生成任何题图，Publication 仍不得执行。
next: A future recovery may proceed only after it can independently verify the v2.5.0 Prompt SHA-256 on the then-current main and re-establish a same-date admission checkpoint under that exact control context.
next_zh: 后续恢复只有在能够对届时最新 main 上的 v2.5.0 Prompt SHA-256 做独立核验，并在该精确控制上下文下重新建立同日 Admission checkpoint 后才可继续。
reason_zh: 当前控制声明与可复用 checkpoint 上下文不一致，且本次无法独立完成 Prompt SHA-256 字节级核验；按硬锁拒绝陈旧上下文。
